payload.summary: Two independent defects on report 1f53ef33-8f50-489b-8505-689740692ab0 (VIC Q1-2026). D1: the resume skip-set is keyed on unit_id with no window_status filter, so a unit pushed FAILED with empty markdown is excluded from every future chunk forever — there is no retry path in any layer. 12 units failed this fire and are now terminal; with 3 from the morning fire that is 15 of 24 pushed units permanently empty, covering pages 20-50 (the entire notes section). finalize_bctc_refine will still mark the report complete. D2: the inverse and arguably worse — units flagged image_unavailable + garbled_ocr_layout shipped as DONE at confidence 0.65-0.75 carrying visibly row-shifted numbers, which downstream consumers will treat as trustworthy.

defect_1_primary.mechanism: window_status is read exactly once in the flow — at :74-77 for the RESET-GUARD has_done_units check — and never for skip-set eligibility. Membership in pushed_ids is by unit_id alone. A FAILED push is therefore indistinguishable from a DONE push to the resume path.
defect_1_primary.consequence: The mechanism that makes this agent safely resumable is the same mechanism that makes a batch failure permanent. No retry, no backlog, no signal — the pages simply never come back.
defect_1_primary.blast_radius_this_report: units 0000, 0001, 0007 (morning fire 09:03-09:05Z) + units 0012-0023 (this fire 16:33-16:34Z) = 15 of 24 pushed units, markdown empty, confidence 0. Pages 1, 2, 11, 20-50.
defect_1_primary.candidate_fix: filter the skip-set on window_status === 'DONE', with a bounded per-unit retry counter so a genuinely unextractable page cannot loop forever. Needs a companion decision on what finalize_bctc_refine should do when any unit is still FAILED at finalize time — today it finalizes regardless.

defect_2_secondary.mechanism: FR-13's contract is numbers<-OCR, structure<-image. Units 0004, 0005, 0006 carry the agent's own flags image_unavailable / image_unavailable:pages6-8 / garbled_ocr_layout — the structure leg provably did not run — yet all three shipped window_status DONE at confidence 0.65-0.75 with full number tables.
evidence_of_corruption_in_unit_0005: Nguyen gia (gross cost) row carries a parenthesized negative (33.020.984) — gross cost is never negative

Du phong ton that dau tu (impairment provision) carries positive 44.670.551 / 35.916.035 while every other provision row in the same table is parenthesized negative — (1.583.814), (3.556.570), (35.946.240)
Dau tu nam giu den ngay dao han dai han carries negative (3.436.252) where the prior-period column is positive 16.567.029
Gia tri hao mon luy ke moves (160.683.471) -> (73.936.379), i.e. accumulated depreciation halving year-on-year on a growing asset base
Net: values are shifted relative to their labels — exactly what the unit's own garbled_ocr_layout flag says — and it still shipped DONE
defect_2_secondary.why_this_is_worse_than_D1: A FAILED unit with empty markdown is loud and self-describing. A DONE unit at 0.65 confidence with plausibly-magnituded but row-shifted numbers passes every null check and every non-zero plausibility check downstream. TONG CONG TAI SAN 1.178.694.748 trieu VND is a believable figure for VIC, so nothing flags it.
defect_2_secondary.candidate_fix: block DONE when image_unavailable is present (the FR-13 structure leg cannot have run), or gate DONE behind a confidence floor. Root cause of the image unavailability itself is likely dev-pdf-extractor, not the flow doc — po to route the two halves separately.

return_vs_ground_truth.verified_true: 12 windows this chunk (unit-0012..0023) — confirmed; all 12 FAILED — confirmed; 24 total pushed — confirmed; NO_FILESYSTEM_OUTPUT true — confirmed, docs/refine-output/ does not exist and nothing landed
return_vs_ground_truth.internal_contradiction: the RETURN says both '16 windows remain for next fire' and 'remaining 28 windows (unit-0024 through unit-0039)'. The named range is 16 units, and 40-24=16, so 28 is the outlier of three statements about one quantity. Benign here — the DB confirms the actual work — but it is the same narrated-summary-drifts / read-back-fields-hold shape seen in the market-watcher EOD case filed earlier today.
return_vs_ground_truth.agent_framing_was_incomplete: the RETURN attributes everything to upstream partitioning or OCR quality, which points at pdf-extractor. That is at most half of it: the durability defect (D1) is in this agent's own flow doc, and D2 is the opposite of what was reported — the problem is the chunk that succeeded, not the chunk that failed.
